annotations.title: Text Stats: words, characters, tokens and SMS segments

description: Text Stats: words, characters, tokens and SMS segments. Use when a task needs counts for a piece of text: words, user-perceived characters, bytes, sentences, paragraphs, lines, reading or speaking time, OpenAI token counts, SMS segments, or a check against length limits such as a character, word, SMS or prompt-token budget. Cost: 1 credit per call.

limits.description: Up to 20 budgets to check the text against. Each is { name, max, unit } where unit is characters, words, tokens_o200k, tokens_cl100k, bytes or sms_segments.

text.description: The text to count. Up to 200,000 UTF-16 code units. Whitespace-only text is valid and counts zero words.

name: text_stats
